benchmarks.description: Matching cached benchmark records. Each carries its own provenance, which may be older than the snapshot when that feed last refreshed earlier.

snapshot.description: Provenance of the benchmark cache as a whole at the moment it was read, so a caller can tell how old the cache is and why the last refresh failed even when benchmarks is empty.

cached.description: Always true: this answer is served from the cache. A read path never triggers a hidden network fetch; refreshing is an explicit benchmarks.refresh job.
